newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Dubai Aluminium Company (Dubal) mulls further hike in production capacity, says chief executive. Dubal's current capacity stands at 375,000 tonnes per year.
- Bids called for UAE's first major private power unit. The project, estimated to be worth between 60 and 120 million dirhams, is to be set up by Dubai Investment company.
- Israel suspends settlement plans in East Jerusalem, Middle East talks to resume.
- Aviation firms eye growing aviation maintenance business in the Middle East.
- Sharjah airport plans expansion project to accommodate more passengers and planes.
- Abu Dhabi considers setting up joint ventures with India.
- UAE and Pakistan resume talks on building an oil refinery in Pakistan.
